company: Alibaba Cloud (Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group), a business group of Alibaba Group Holding Limited

ownership.parent: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (public company, NYSE: BABA, SEHK: 9988)
ownership.quote: Alibaba Cloud ... is a cloud computing company, a subsidiary of Alibaba Group.

stage.quote: In March 2023, Alibaba announced its "1+6+N" restructuring plan, which reorganized its business structure into six independently run entities: Cloud Intelligence Group, Taobao and Tmall Group, Cainiao Smart Logistics Network...
stage.note: Alibaba Cloud (Container Service for Kubernetes / ACK is one of its products) is the Cloud Intelligence Group business unit of Alibaba Group Holding Limited, a publicly traded company (NYSE: BABA, SEHK: 9988). It is not an independently funded startup; there is no separate venture funding history for Alibaba Cloud as such. Alibaba Group itself IPO'd in 2014 (NYSE) and listed secondarily in Hong Kong in 2019, so at the parent level the stage is 'public'.

investors: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (parent; public shareholders via NYSE: BABA / SEHK: 9988)

revenue.basis: Whole-company (Alibaba Group Holding Limited) revenue from its Form 20-F annual report; figure is for the entire group, not the Cloud Intelligence Group / ACK product line specifically. Cloud segment revenue alone could not be confirmed within the research window.

employees.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alibaba_Group (citing Alibaba Group FY2025 Annual Report, Form 20-F)

note: Alibaba Cloud ACK (Container Service for Kubernetes) is a product of Alibaba Cloud, itself the 'Cloud Intelligence Group' business unit of Alibaba Group Holding Limited — a publicly traded, diversified technology/e-commerce conglomerate (NYSE: BABA, SEHK: 9988), not an independently funded startup. There is no separate accelerator history, funding round, or standalone revenue figure for ACK; revenue shown is for the whole Alibaba Group. Under the 2023 '1+6+N' restructuring, Cloud Intelligence Group was set up as an independently run entity able to seek its own fundraising/listing, but no external funding round or IPO for Cloud Intelligence Group specifically was confirmed as of this check.
